title: 480Y/277 V three-phase utility service, 1000 kVA transformer

sources.citation: A three-phase liquid-filled substation or pad-mounted transformer for an industrial plant: 1000 kVA, with an impedance of 5.75 %, a long-standing typical value for the size, and an X/R ratio of about 5–7, from published manufacturers' data and short-circuit study guides (paraphrased, not one vendor's). An X/R of 6 is taken: per phase 0.0575 × (√3 × 277)² / 1 000 000 = 13.2 mΩ, about 20.9 kA of bolted three-phase fault current, the infinite-primary (transformer-limited) available fault current: an upper bound, with no utility system impedance.

277 V from each phase to the neutral of the 480Y/277 V three-phase four-wire nominal system of ANSI C84.1-2020 (the region profile's industrial system); 480 V is the rounded name of 277 × √3 = 479.78 V.
game-design: a placeholder size and terminal layout. Three-phase service is headless in P2 (gameplay is P6), so it is not drawn.
